title: 19-BCV-016 - Sprinkler systems with antifreeze solutions
code_edition: National Building Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NBC(AE)); National Fire Code – 2019 Alberta Edition (NFC(AE))

facts.text: The joint variance sets conditions for antifreeze solutions used to reduce freezing in sprinkler systems exposed to Alberta climates of −20°C or colder.
For existing systems, owners/contractors may maintain their designed freeze-protection level; concentrations must not be reduced unless alternate freeze protection is in place.
facts.locator: Same PDF, p. 2, Application and Variance

facts.text: New systems must be designed for typical Alberta freeze protection or use alternative measures; examples include insulation, monitored heat tracing, dry-pipe, or pre-action systems.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
